verdict.rationale: three.js ships first-party addons and tools: GLTFLoader, OrbitControls and TransformControls, SVG/CSS3D renderers as addons, an online editor, and a devtools extension. It also has very large npm reach (12.2M weekly downloads). However, nothing in the pack shows an asset store or marketplace of ready-made models, or a curated third-party plugin ecosystem, and community users report friction getting basic model loading (OBJ) working from the examples addons. Missing for 10: an asset store or model marketplace, evidence of a third-party plugin/package ecosystem, and independent corroboration that ready-made assets are easy to obtain and use.
